t.zh: 没人说话时总线一直是隐性。一个控制器开口，先说一位显性：这一位叫<wiki-ref to="sof"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: With nobody talking the bus stays recessive. A controller that starts talking first says one dominant bit: the <wiki-ref to="sof"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 可一帧里面到处都有显性。只有在总线确实安静过一阵以后的那个显性，才是一帧的开头。
t.en: Yet a frame is full of dominant bits. Only the dominant bit after the bus has really been quiet for a while is where a frame begins.

after.zh: 一帧的最后是 11 位隐性：应答界定位、7 位帧结束、3 位帧间间隔。所以两帧紧挨着时，这条规则照样认得出下一帧。
after.en: A frame ends with 11 recessive bits: the ACK delimiter, 7 bits of end of frame and 3 of intermission. So even with frames back to back, this rule still finds the next one.

brief.zh: 总线连着至少 11 拍隐性之后的第一个显性，回答「是」；其余每一拍回答「否」。
brief.en: Answer yes on the first dominant bit after at least 11 recessive ones in a row, and no on every other tick.

hint.zh: 数出这一拍之前隐性连着多长。
hint.en: Count how long the recessive run before this tick is.

hint.zh: 显性是 0，可以拿它和常数 0 比。
hint.en: Dominant is 0, and can be compared with a constant 0.
